about.title: FarmCraft
about.description: The CommitCraft SVG flow, replanted in a warm pixel-farm language.
about.whatIsThisContent: FarmCraft transforms GitHub user contributions, repository info, and statistics into previewable, downloadable, and embeddable pixel-farm SVGs. Perfect for READMEs, personal pages, portfolios, or sharing directly.
about.inputUsernameDetail: Generates Contribution Map, Banner Hall, and Player Passport views.
about.inputShortDetail: Directly generates a Repo Card, great for project overviews.
about.inputUrlDetail: Auto-parses owner/repo, handy for pasting GitHub page URLs.
about.resultMapDetail: Turns the annual contribution heatmap into a 2D solid-color grass matrix where darker plots mean more activity.
about.resultBannerDetail: Turns GitHub stats into Terraria-like loot badges with the number as the hero.
about.resultPassportDetail: Creates a farmer profile card with a customizable quote.
about.resultRepoDetail: Displays repo name, description, language, and popularity in a farm-style SVG.
about.step1: Enter a GitHub username, short repo format, or full repo URL in the input box.
about.step2_suffix: and wait for the page to generate the content.
about.step4_suffix: ; copyable endpoints are provided below for embedding in READMEs or web pages.
about.step5: Player Passport supports custom quotes; Loot Hall keeps the numbers front and center; Repo Card supports direct export.
about.apiStatIdNote_suffix: for Loot Hall is provided as a copy button next to each badge — no need to memorize it.
about.note1: Exports are primarily SVG for easy editing, web embedding, and crisp scaling; tiles come from Kenney's CC0 farm expansion.
about.note2: Both user mode and repo mode work with public GitHub data sources.
about.note3: Repo Card download now supports mixed CJK/Latin content export without losing Chinese descriptions.
